column1: # SCV recommended effort per model — the value and the sentence come from the official prompting guide copied in this folder.
# Format (tab-separated): <model id> <recommended: low|medium|high|xhigh|max> <condition or -> <the guide's sentence, verbatim> <source file>.
# SCV asks once when the session's effort differs from the recommended value; the user changes it (core 0.89.0+). check.sh verifies every sentence against its source file.

column4: Use `high` as the default for most tasks, with `xhigh` for the most capability-sensitive workloads and `medium` or `low` for routine work.
Start at the default [effort](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort) level, `high`, then test the other levels (`low`, `medium`, `xhigh`, and `max`) against your own evals.
Start at `high`, the default on the Claude API.

column3: 코딩 · 에이전트 일은 xhigh, 그 밖의 일은 high 이상
column4: Start with the `xhigh` effort level for coding and agentic use cases, and use a minimum of `high` effort for most intelligence-sensitive use cases.
Start with the default (`high`) and adjust based on your evals
Start at `medium`, the default on Claude Opus 5.5
On Claude Sonnet 5, effort defaults to `high`, the same as on Claude Sonnet 4.6.

column3: 잘 정의된 에이전트 코딩 · 여러 단계 도구 쓰기는 medium 에서 시작, 더 어렵거나 긴 일은 high
column4: Start at `high`, the default on the Claude API, unless your workload is agentic or latency-sensitive. For agentic coding and multistep tool use, start at `medium` for well-specified tasks and move to `high` for harder or longer ones.
`medium` is the default. Start here for most work, including agentic coding.
